intro: ENTI is Penn State's intercollege minor in Entrepreneurship and Innovation — open to any major, 18–20 credits. It is where the stuff we do on weekends counts for credit.
reasons: Customer research, prototypes, pitching — the hackathon loop, with a grade attached.
Intercollege, so the whole team can take it, not just the engineers.
An internship or independent study can count toward it.

tracks.name: Entrepreneurship & Innovation

courses: ENGR / IST / MGMT 425 — New Venture Creation
